label: Ок / Ёк
description: A 10-sentence card for the diminutive suffix -ок/-ёк.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: сынок from сын. The suffix -ок turns сын 'son' into сынок 'little son', adding warmth and tenderness rather than literal smallness.
Strategic focus: дружок from друг. The suffix -ок makes друг 'friend' into дружок 'dear little friend', conveying affection and familiar closeness.
Strategic focus: голосок from голос. The suffix -ок shrinks голос 'voice' into голосок 'little voice', suggesting a thin, small, gentle sound.
Strategic focus: чаёк from чай. The suffix -ёк turns чай 'tea' into чаёк 'nice little tea', adding a cosy, indulgent, affectionate flavour.
Strategic focus: пирожок from пирог. The suffix -ок makes пирог 'pie' into пирожок 'little pie', naming a small hand pie with a homely warmth.
Strategic focus: городок from город. The suffix -ок turns город 'city' into городок 'little town', marking a small settlement with a cosy nuance.
Strategic focus: contrast город and городок. The plain город names a large city, while городок with -ок signals a small town; the pair shows the suffix adding smallness.
Strategic focus: голосок from голос. Here -ок gives голосок 'little voice' a tender, coaxing tone, often used when speaking to a child.
Strategic focus: сынок from сын. The suffix -ок makes сынок 'little son' a familiar, loving form of address rather than a comment on size.
Strategic focus: пирожок from пирог. The suffix -ок turns пирог 'pie' into пирожок 'little pie', emphasising the small, single serving offered with care.
